(A) 7am to 9am
(B) 9am to 6pm
(C) 8pm to 10pm
(D) 6pm to 8pm

The only overlapping time period where David could have been at the construction site is from 8pm to 10pm, as this is the only time when he could be at the train station according to Lisa and the construction site is closed after 10pm.
